CustomField.description: When this item is due, computed at fan-out as Transaction__c.Contract_Executed_Date__c plus Transaction_Task_Def__mdt.Due_Day_Offset__c. PARITY FIELD replacing Task.ActivityDate: without it Transaction__c.Tasks_Overdue__c and the Overdue Tasks report have no source at all and would report zero overdue on every deal forever. Date, not DateTime - the offsets are whole days and no time of day is ever meaningful here.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Date this item is due, calculated from the contract execution date plus the offset in the checklist definition.
CustomField.label: Due Date
